name: Architecture Documentation Required
description: Every Architecture Deliverable requires a reviewed ADR documenting context, alternatives, and consequences before Approval.

conditions.statement: An ADR record exists, linked to this Architecture Deliverable.

requiredEvidence.title: ADR Record
requiredEvidence.description: An ADR record exists, linked to this Architecture Deliverable.

conditions.statement: The ADR documents the problem context motivating the decision.

requiredEvidence.title: ADR Record — Context
requiredEvidence.description: The ADR documents the problem context motivating the decision.

conditions.statement: The ADR documents at least one alternative that was considered and rejected, with rationale.

requiredEvidence.title: ADR Record — Alternatives Considered
requiredEvidence.description: The ADR documents at least one alternative that was considered and rejected, with rationale.

exceptionRules.exceptionStatement: A decision with no viable alternative (single-vendor constraint, regulatory mandate) may state 'no alternative' explicitly, with justification, in place of a rejected option.
exceptionRules.reviewRequirements: Justification is recorded in the ADR itself; no separate review required.

conditions.statement: The ADR documents both positive and negative consequences of the decision, including identified risk.

requiredEvidence.title: ADR Record — Consequences
requiredEvidence.description: The ADR documents both positive and negative consequences of the decision, including identified risk.

conditions.statement: The ADR was reviewed and approved by an Architecture-capability participant other than its author.

requiredEvidence.title: Review Result
requiredEvidence.description: The ADR was reviewed and approved by an Architecture-capability participant other than its author.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: Recorded outcome from the review process

exceptionRules.exceptionStatement: A single-architect SEU (no second Architecture participant available) may substitute Authority sign-off for peer review, logged as a governance exception.
exceptionRules.duration: For the duration of this SEU's single-architect staffing
exceptionRules.reviewRequirements: Re-evaluated if a second Architecture participant joins the SEU.
